channel.title: LoomSci - Matter Science
channel.description: Latest Matter Science articles from LoomSci

item.title: A Gentle Squash Unravels Helices: The Hidden Grammar of Packing in Imperfect Tubes
item.description: Even a slight squash of a cylindrical tube disrupts perfect helices, forcing hard spheres into complex patterns with alternating chirality.

item.title: The Soliton That Learns to Tunnel: How Quantum Chirality Hides in Spin Chains
item.description: A chiral soliton in a quantum spin chain tunnels between lattice sites, its hopping amplitude governed by a topological Berry phase that alternates with spin parity.

item.title: When Hydrogen's Simplest Electron Refuses to Quench
item.description: A hydrogen atom’s electron remains unpaired inside a boron-nitride cage, enabling ferromagnetism from s-electrons in a designed crystal.

item.title: Mapping the Seven Phases of Anderson Localization
item.description: Scientists map all seven transport phases of Anderson localization within a single photonic Floquet lattice, including the elusive triple coexistence of extended, critical, and localized states.

item.title: Teaching Atoms to Bond: A Molecular Hand for Mechanosynthesis
item.description: A molecular tool on an STM tip donates carbon atoms to or abstracts silicon atoms from a surface, enabling atom-by-atom mechanosynthesis.

item.title: Steering the Unsteerable: AI Learns to Control Liquid Crystal Defects
item.description: A deep reinforcement learning agent learns to steer a self-propelled topological defect through a microfluidic maze, revealing hidden rules of active nematics.

item.title: When a Language Model Learns to Read Its Own Homework
item.description: An LLM iteratively designs molecules by reading full quantum-mechanical explanations of its previous failures, achieving sub-thermal precision in property optimization.

item.title: Light Caught Trembling in a Curved Spacetime on a Chip
item.description: A photonic chip emulates curved anti-de Sitter spacetime, where a light beam's geodesic sway and rapid Zitterbewegung trembling reveal Dirac dynamics in a fabricated geometry.

item.title: When Nanophotonics Learns to Obey the Rules
item.description: A learned generative manifold enforces nanophotonic design rules from the start, yielding manufacturable devices that match or exceed conventional performance with far lower computational cost.
